messages:
Ana (Finance): FYI postmortem follow-up for last week's delayed-usage spike. Root cause summary: late ingest + dedupe gap caused ~2.4M token overcount in the ledger; some invoices already went out. Need owners for containment, backfill plan, customer comms, and an ETA for invoice corrections.
Jordan (SRE): ack. I can own immediate containment (routing + replay safe-window). Quick Q: do we want a hotfix in the ingest pipeline or just stop the bad upstream feed temporarily?
Sam (Billing Eng): I'd prefer stop-and-replay. Hotfix risks more duplicates unless we freeze watermark. I can add a short-lived delta-reserve to prevent double-crediting during replay.
Liz (Customer Ops): For impacted customers we need a comms draft and credit plan. I can start templating SLO-friendly language. Who has the canonical affected-account list?
Mike (Revenue Ops): I have a rough list from last night's reconciliation. Will attach full CSV to the ticket. We also need a way to tag invoices that will be corrected so downstream billing systems don't auto-charge collections.
Ana (Finance): Owners: Jordan = containment & replay plan, Sam = backfill/query + credit calc, Liz = customer comms, Mike = invoice tagging and ops. Can each confirm ETA for primary deliverable this week?
Jordan (SRE): containment plan by EOD today. Steps: 1) block offending source, 2) enable ingest dry-run, 3) freeze watermark at T=2026-06-14T02:00Z, 4) queue replay with dedupe keys. I'll post runbook snippet.
Sam (Billing Eng): backfill query and credit delta calc by 48h. Query is a windowed join on ingest events vs ledger. snippet: ```sql
-- identify late arrivals
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens_delta) as delta
FROM ingest_events
WHERE event_ts > ledger_watermark AND source != 'trusted'
GROUP BY account_id;
```
Liz (Customer Ops): I'll draft comms tonight and ping legal for wording. Target to send initial heads-up within 72h after we confirm affected list.
Mike (Revenue Ops): I'll block the invoices flagged by tag "billing-correction-pending" and create the invoice-correction queue. ETA 24h to set up tagging and prevent auto-collections.
Sam (Billing Eng): Note: we should add a safety check before credits run — run a sample verification against live accounts (top 20 by delta). I can run that once query is ready.
Jordan (SRE): ops-bot: created incident-7212 with checklist and ownership.
ops-bot: Incident 7212 created by Jordan. Checklist: containment, replay, backfill, credit calc, comms, invoice tagging. See https://redwood.internal/incidents/7212
Ana (Finance): Good. Two follow-ups: (1) timeline alignment — can we commit to final invoice corrections and credits within 10 business days? (2) recurring pattern detection — Sam/Jordan can you add a metric to surface late-arrival spikes so we don't repeat?
Sam (Billing Eng): 10 business days looks doable if replay and verification go smooth. I'll add a Grafana panel for late-arrival rate and an alert threshold.
Jordan (SRE): I'll wire an automatic guard: if late-arrival rate > 0.5% of daily tokens for 3h, auto-pause that source and create a ticket.
Liz (Customer Ops): I'll prepare a comms cadence: initial heads-up, mid-update at reconciliation, final correction notice. Template will include expected timeline and invoice impacts.
Mike (Revenue Ops): I'll coordinate with collections to ensure no dunning while corrections pending. Also will prepare a one-off credit run playbook.
Ana (Finance): Thanks. Can everyone add their primary checklist items to incident-7212 and set the owner field? I'll compile into a single remediation timeline doc and handoff to execs.
Sam (Billing Eng): done — added query PR #843 and checklist items to 7212.
Jordan (SRE): containment steps added and scheduled replay window for 2026-06-16 02:30Z.
Liz (Customer Ops): comms draft uploaded to 7212/attachments/comms-draft-v1.md.
Mike (Revenue Ops): invoice tagging applied to staging; will promote to prod after a smoke test. ETA 6h.
Ana (Finance): Great progress. Quick ask: flag any downstream risks (analytics, metrics, partner reports) so we can coordinate corrections there too.
Jordan (SRE): noted — analytics will see late tokens too; I'll add a memo for Data Platform to coordinate backfill.
Sam (Billing Eng): one last note — create a delta-reserve account so credits are staged and reviewed before posting. I'll add flow to the PR.
Ana (Finance): Perfect. Closing out for now — we'll do a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to verify containment and rehearsals. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
